name: statem-single-agent
description: A minimal StateM profile for durable single-agent task phases.

interface.shortDescription: Track durable state for multi-phase local work.
interface.longDescription: Use an external StateM installation when one local task has at least three substantial phases or mutable execution state that must outlive context.
defaultPrompt: Use $statem-single-agent locally for at least three substantial phases or durable mutable state that may outlive context.
